# Gate metrics

<!-- Generated by scripts/gate_metrics.py; edit the script, not this file. -->

Measured wall times from recorded canonical gate observations on `macOS-27.0.1-arm64-arm-64bit` with Python 3.12.16 at `2026-11-12T13:56:34Z`.

First successful measurements retained for each arm. Package initially failed twice because offline pandas wheel metadata was unavailable; only package and the not-yet-run render arm were then run after SHA-256-verified acquisition of the exact pandas wheel in uv.lock. Those failures remain in this receipt’s runs. UV_FIND_LINKS pointed to that verified local wheelhouse for the successful package run. Baseline and after test selections differ by the new regression cases. No speedup is claimed.

Refresh with:

```bash
uv run python scripts/release_check.py --arm all --arm test --arm render \
    --timings /tmp/gate-after.json
uv run python scripts/gate_metrics.py --record-timings /tmp/gate-after.json
```

Baseline workloads that are not equivalent to their arms:

- `package` failed: Command '['uv', 'build']' returned non-zero exit status 2.

Baseline conditions: One run per arm before this estate change on the same host and interpreter. Warm caches and host load are uncontrolled; failed observations are retained. The render arm was measured separately after the package cache miss.

The baseline and current receipts are historical evidence. Timings include host load and warm caches; they are not a controlled benchmark.
